description: The procedure/service code itself (e.g., 99213, 27447, MS-DRG 470).
policy_rationale: The unit of analysis. Everything joins to this.

description: Code system: CPT, HCPCS, MS-DRG, APR-DRG, NDC, etc.
policy_rationale: Same number means different things across systems; required to interpret the code.

description: Year/version of the code system.
policy_rationale: Code definitions drift yearly; needed for clean time-series comparison.

description: Payer's free-text label for the service.
policy_rationale: Human readability and sanity-checking; not standardized so don't analyze on it.

description: ffs | bundle | capitation.
policy_rationale: Bundled/capitated rates are NOT comparable to fee-for-service; must segregate.

description: The negotiated amount. Dollars for most types; a whole-number percent when type=percentage.
policy_rationale: The headline variable for any price analysis.

description: negotiated | derived | fee schedule | percentage | per diem.
policy_rationale: MUST read before using the rate, or you mix dollars with percentages and per-diems.

description: Rate end date; 9999-12-31 = evergreen/no expiry.
policy_rationale: Distinguishes active vs stale contract terms; filter the sentinel intentionally.

description: professional | institutional | both.
policy_rationale: Professional (physician) vs institutional (facility) prices are different markets.

description: inpatient | outpatient | both.
policy_rationale: Site-of-care price differences are a major policy question.

description: CMS place-of-service code(s); required for professional class.
policy_rationale: Office vs facility vs ED location drives price; supports site-neutral analysis.

description: CPT/HCPCS modifiers.
policy_rationale: Occasionally needed to disambiguate (e.g., bilateral, professional component).

description: DRG severity indicator (free text).
policy_rationale: Relevant only for DRG-based inpatient analysis.

description: Integer key linking a rate to a provider group (crosswalk join key).
policy_rationale: The join backbone; rate rows carry only this id, not NPIs.

description: National Provider Identifier(s); type-1 individual or type-2 org. [0] when TIN-only.
policy_rationale: Identifies WHO is paid; lets us target specific TX systems/hospitals.

description: Tax ID (ein or npi) and value.
policy_rationale: Group-level provider identity; useful when NPI rosters are incomplete.

description: Org name (required alongside EIN under schema 2.0).
policy_rationale: Human-readable provider/system attribution.

description: Network label(s) for the provider group (e.g., TX Blue Choice PPO).
policy_rationale: Lets us scope to Texas networks and compare across networks.

description: The payer/issuer/TPA publishing the file.
policy_rationale: Identifies the payer for cross-payer comparison.

description: e.g., third-party administrator, health insurance issuer.
policy_rationale: Self-funded vs fully-insured context.

description: EIN or HIOS plan identifier.
policy_rationale: Links rates to a specific employer plan or marketplace product.

description: group | individual.
policy_rationale: Distinguishes employer vs individual-market products.

description: Plan and employer-sponsor names.
policy_rationale: Employer-level attribution (self-funded/ASO files).

description: MRF filename the row came from.
policy_rationale: Reproducibility and debugging.

description: Publication/last-updated date of the file.
policy_rationale: Time dimension for trend analysis; which monthly drop this is.

description: CMS schema version of the file.
policy_rationale: Guards against silent structure changes across months/payers.

description: Our internal payer id and TX/network tags.
policy_rationale: Keeps the multi-payer, multi-month warehouse organized.

description: Dollars the plan paid an OON provider PLUS enrollee cost share.
policy_rationale: OON benchmark; but suppressed when <20 claims, so sparse.

description: Total charges billed by the OON provider.
policy_rationale: Charge-to-allowed ratios; markup analysis.

description: Provider identifiers on the OON record.
policy_rationale: Attribute OON amounts to providers.
